thread:
josh-sales: quick ask — Aurora Supply hit a huge onboarding burst last week, invoiced for it, now asking for a retroactive ramp credit. can we triage?
sam-revops: filing details: customer migrated March 1, expected daily tokens 50k, actual spike Mar 9–11 ~350k/day across 3 days. invoice INV-2026-0456 reflects the overage.
josh-sales: customer says spike caused by test data import, not production usage. they want a one-time credit to smooth conversion. sales asks for $12k credit.
maria-finance: need the math and margin impact before approving. what's the ARR/contract terms? any committed minimums?
sam-revops: contract is 12m, $120k annual committed usage (50k tokens/day baseline). No explicit ramp-credit clause. quick calc: extra tokens = (350k-50k)*3 = 900k tokens. Current list rate = $0.02 / 1k tokens => gross extra charge calc looks off due to decimal confusion. corrected per-1k rate = $20.00 => 900 * $20 = $18,000.
josh-sales: sales proposal was $12k to preserve the relationship and not delay onboarding.
maria-finance: margin check — with cost of goods at ~30% on hosted, $12k credit reduces gross margin by $3.6k. acceptable if revenue stickiness improves. need approval from finance lead.
erin-legal: flag — if we adjust invoice retroactively, we must record an addendum to the SOW and include an explicit ramp-credit clause for future enrollments. also need to confirm tax consequences.
maria-finance: okay but let's cap it: approve up to $12k contingent on signed addendum stating one-time, non-precedent, and customer will accept updated T&Cs.
josh-sales: will draft amendment and send to @aurora. can we do a partial immediate credit and remainder after addendum? customer prefers immediate.
maria-finance: split is fine: $6k immediate adjustment, $6k pending addendum executed within 14 days. create a dated memo for auditors.
billing-bot: created credit memo CM-2026-1123 for $6,000 against INV-2026-0456 and a pending adjustment hold ADJ-PENDING-78912 for $6,000.
erin-legal: I will review the amendment draft; include clause: "one-time ramp credit, not to be construed as ongoing pricing" and add a signature block.
sam-revops: tagging internal checklist: 1) apply CM-2026-1123; 2) hold ADJ-PENDING-78912 pending signed addendum; 3) update revenue recognition note.
josh-sales: thx all — I’ll send amendment and ping once signed. customer is happy with split. :thumbsup: 
maria-finance: logging approval thread for internal audit. please drop final docs here when complete. :white_check_mark: 
erin-legal: approved language received, minor wording change requested.
josh-sales: update — Aurora signed amendment at 2987654370, please release pending adjustment.
billing-bot: ADJ-PENDING-78912 released and applied, final credit memo CM-2026-1123 updated to $12,000. ledger note LR-2026-556 attached.
maria-finance: closing — credit applied and docs filed. moving to archive. :lock:
